U.note: Rich, well-built bento with working roast, subscription, cafe and guide controls, but the logo text vanishes on mobile and the debug state line clutters the page.

V.note: Bold poster-style page with a tidy floating bento panel and working controls, though the panel covers the headline and the intro text is cramped.

W.note: Compact, coherent bento drop-down with varied tiles and a working bag stepper, but fairly thin in content.

X.note: Inventive stacked-tins concept with a good grid, but the tiles are small, rotated and text-light, and the header sits awkwardly.

Y.note: Ambitious ordering UI with a good tile layout, but the size pills are nearly invisible on the dark card and the page is empty at rest.

Z.note: Cleanest and most complete bento menu, with collapsible tiles, roast and bag state, Escape and click-outside handling, and a layout that holds up on mobile.
